scripts.build:web: node scripts/stamp-build.js && set "NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096" && expo export --platform web --max-workers 2 && node scripts/patch-html.js && node scripts/gen-seo-pages.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting --project cnd-homesang
scripts.deploy:functions: cd functions && npm run build && cd .. && set "FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120" && firebase deploy --only functions --project cnd-homesang
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --config firebase.rulestest.json --project homesang-rules-test "node scripts/test-rules.mjs"
scripts.test:rules:core: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --config firebase.rulestest.json --project homesang-core-test "node scripts/test-rules-core.mjs"
scripts.test:rules:all: npm run test:rules && npm run test:rules:core && npm run test:rules:cnd
scripts.test:rules:cnd: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --config firebase.rulestest.json --project homesang-cnd-test "node scripts/test-rules-cnd.mjs"
